instructions: Sauté the onion in a large pot over medium heat until soft and slightly browned. Add the garlic and sauté, mixing, for about 3 minutes.
Add the ground meat and break it into small pieces. Brown the meat until no longer pink.
Stir in the taco seasoning, cumin, coriander, and cayenne or crushed black pepper; mix well.
Add the tomato sauce and half a can of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes or longer while the pasta cooks.
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Drain, add it to the sauce, and mix well.
Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, then serve.
notes: Handwritten family recipe submitted as a photo of a recipe page. Meat dish. The "seasonings — taco" line reads as taco seasoning and is flagged for review. Pasta is cooked separately and mixed into the sauce at the end.
